candidate_evidence.quote: Participants will receive YSCH-01 in combination with atezolizumab.

coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (translational subset). YSCH-01 is an adenovirus product (keyword 'Adenovirus', dosed in viral particles); the record never says 'oncolytic' or 'gene therapy', so it was coded as excluded_intervention_type by analogy with the vaccine/virus rule. Atezolizumab is then the only investigational pharmacological agent, hence experimental_monotherapy (manual 3.1 rule 4, as pembrolizumab + vaccine example). Brief summary says randomised but design says NON_RANDOMIZED; not coded here.
